paragraph: The Granville composite delivers a constructive 60/100, though the reading is actively capped by a classic breadth divergence warning as headline indexes climb while the equal-weight RSP/SPY ratio weakens by -0.16%. Internal risk appetite remains selectively robust, powered by aggressive high-beta leadership (SPHB/SPLV up +1.93%) and surging semiconductor bellwethers (SOXX/SPY up +1.26%), yet Dow Theory caution lingers with transports lagging sharply (IYT/SPY down -0.95%). Macro conditions offer a remarkably tranquil backdrop, underscored by an -11.60% drop in the VIX to a calm 15.77, a steady 10-year real yield at 2.46%, and high-yield spreads pinned at 2.70%, even as small-cap underperformance (0.3782) reinforces the narrow nature of this tape. Consequently, the directional lean for the session is cautiously bullish, favoring targeted momentum in large-cap tech while fading unconfirmed broad-market breakouts until participation broadens.
